title: Ready to turn in
caption: With every objective but the Turn in step ticked, the story card shows the game's ready-to-turn-in marker and says "Ready to turn in" instead of the count; the Turn in row stays listed.

title: Story complete
caption: Once the guide's last story quest is turned in, the card shows the journal's completed-quest check.

title: Active quest (no change)
caption: Mid-quest on a phone the card keeps the active diamond and the objective count, as before.
